Licenses
========

Conker's Bad Fur Day: Recompiled is built from code under several licenses. Its
complete source is at https://github.com/sciaschi/CBFD-Recompiled (the tag
named after this release), with the changes it makes to the tools it uses in
recomp/*.patch.

- This project's own code: the MIT License (LICENSE).

- N64ModernRuntime (librecomp and ultramodern), which runs the recompiled game:
  the GNU General Public License, version 3 (LICENSE-GPL-3.0.txt).
  https://github.com/N64Recomp/N64ModernRuntime
  As the program includes it, the program as a whole is distributed under the
  GPL version 3, which also gives you the right to its source (above).

- RT64, the renderer: the MIT License. https://github.com/rt64/rt64
  Its live texture pack matching (src/hle/rt64_rice_hash.cpp, added by
  recomp/rt64.patch) is under the GNU General Public License, version 2 or
  later: it imitates the Rice texture hashing of GlideHQ (Hiroshi Morii, as in
  GLideN64's src/GLideNHQ/TxUtil.cpp) and of Rice Video (Rice1964,
  mupen64plus-video-rice), both under the GPL version 2 or later.

- N64Recomp: the MIT License. https://github.com/N64Recomp/N64Recomp

- RecompFrontend (the launcher and menus) and the other libraries included
  (such as SDL2) keep their own licenses; see their repositories.

Conker's Bad Fur Day is (c) Rare Ltd. This project is not affiliated with or
endorsed by Rare, Microsoft or Nintendo, and contains no game data.
